test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Both the criminals were cruel and ________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**brutal**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**brutal**" means savagely violent or inhumanely cruel. (क्रूर)
 
• Describing criminals as "brutal" emphasizes their extreme cruelty and harshness.
 
• The other options: "**warm**," "**sympathetic**," and "**diligent**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Both the criminals were cruel and brutal__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Warm (गरमजोशी से भरा)**: Having or showing affection, kindness, or enthusiasm.
 
• **Sympathetic (सहानुभूतिपूर्ण)**: Feeling, showing, or expressing sympathy.
 
• **Diligent (परिश्रमी)**: Showing care and conscientiousness in one's work or duties.

4f:Td12,

The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
